not_found.searched: QD brochure 1500-103 Rev. E1 and QD Europe MPMS 3 product description; only a 9 mm chamber I.D. and option-specific holder sizes (oven 160x5x0.5 mm holder, pressure cell 7 mm) are stated, no general usable sample length.
OptiCool Specifications sheet, OptiCool brochure 1318-016 and wiring options sheet: sample stated to be 'in cryostat vacuum space' but no numerical base pressure is given.

Cryostream 800 manual (intended use, technical data, nozzle alignment): only 'sample of less than 1mm3', the central 2 mm of the stream and 5-8 mm nozzle distance are given; no sample length along the stream axis.
Anton Paar TTK 600 product page and PANalytical datasheet PN10467: only X-ray beam access (2theta 0-164 deg) is documented; no statement on optical (visible/IR) windows or their absence.
Anton Paar TTK 600 product page and PANalytical datasheet: sample size 14 x 10 mm given, no maximum sample thickness/height.
HelioxVT product guide (PSI copy): sample stated 'in vacuum' (IVC) but no IVC base pressure given; newer Oxford Instruments HelioxVT brochures now redirect to qd-oxford.com and could not be read.
HelioxVT product guide: only a 'line of sight to IVC' pumping port and a beam path for neutrons/X-rays are shown; no optical windows or explicit absence documented.
HelioxVT product guide: only IVC inner diameter 25 mm stated; no usable sample length below the 3He pot.
ProteoxMX brochure, Proteox Family brochure and qd-oxford.com Proteox MX page: no statement that the sample space is evacuated (no OVC/IVC vacuum figure).
Same documents: no sample-space vacuum/base-pressure specification.
Same documents: plate diameter 360 mm, puck diameters 60/72 mm and magnet bores 77-150 mm stated, but no usable sample height below the mixing chamber or on the puck.

ST-500 datasheet: sample-to-window distance is specified per order ('Specify the distance from the sample mounting surface to the inside of the top window at time of order'); no standard maximum sample height.
attoDRY2100 datasheet 1009389 and product page: only the 48/49 mm sample-space diameter is given, no usable height.

notes: 8 configurations from 7 manufacturers (Quantum Design, Oxford Cryosystems, Anton Paar, Oxford Instruments, Quantum Design Oxford/Oxford NanoScience, Lake Shore/Janis, attocube). All values are manufacturer specifications read from the cited PDFs/pages on 2026-10-31/11-01; PDF quotes are whitespace-normalised text extractions (superscripts lost, e.g. '10-2 mbar' = 1e-2 mbar). Sourced absences: no magnet (Cryostream 800, TTK 600, HelioxVT system), no evacuated sample space (MPMS 3 pumped-helium chamber, attoDRY2100 exchange gas, Cryostream open stream). Typical-only values: ST-500 stability and base pressure, MPMS 3 sweep rate. Gaps (not_found): sample.height.max on 7/8, pressure.base on OptiCool/HelioxVT/Proteox, vacuum.available on Proteox MX, optical_access on TTK 600 and HelioxVT. Not covered for lack of reachable complete datasheets: UHV ARPES/STM manipulators (Scienta Omicron cryo-manipulator brochure lacks pressure and sample size), neutron Orange cryostats (facility-specific), ESR900 (no datasheet online), LHe storage dewars (Cryofab CMSH sheet unreadable). Tavily quota was exhausted; documents were read via WebFetch/pymupdf and the built-in browser.
